# אריאל פיתוח תוכנה — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Ariel Software Development is a one-person expert consultancy specializing in Microsoft Access systems with over 25 years of hands-on experience. The brand identity is built around being the trusted 'rescue expert' — the professional who steps in when systems fail, developers disappear, or legacy databases become liabilities. The tone is direct, results-driven, and confidence-inspiring, emphasizing that in 90% of cases, systems can be fixed without rebuilding from scratch. The business has a proven track record with real-world deployments including Yad Vashem, school networks, safety management systems, and equestrian associations — projecting deep credibility and enterprise-level expertise.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About אריאל פיתוח תוכנה
Ariel Software Development is a one-person expert consultancy specializing in Microsoft Access systems with over 25 years of hands-on experience. The brand identity is built around being the trusted 'rescue expert' — the professional who steps in when systems fail, developers disappear, or legacy databases become liabilities. The tone is direct, results-driven, and confidence-inspiring, emphasizing that in 90% of cases, systems can be fixed without rebuilding from scratch. The business has a proven track record with real-world deployments including Yad Vashem, school networks, safety management systems, and equestrian associations — projecting deep credibility and enterprise-level expertise.

## Target Audience
- עסקים קטנים ובינוניים, ארגונים, מנהלי תפעול, מנהלי IT ומנהלי כספים עם מערכות Access קיימות
- עסקים קטנים ובינוניים עם בעיות Access
- מנהלי IT עם מערכות Access
- מנהלי כספים עם מערכות Access
